digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center wiki renderer adapter
propositions: Render safe Markdown units (headings, lists, prose) to Jira wiki markup via pandoc while preserving fenced code, ASCII tables, regex-dense, and HTML-dense blocks byte-identically.
Add optional jira-dc extra with exact pypandoc-binary==1.17 pin, lazy import with guard_import, and fallback returning exact input on missing dependency or conversion failure.
Detect and wrap ASCII tables (two or more pipe-bearing lines with delimiter row) once in {noformat}; detect and preserve existing {noformat} blocks to prevent nesting.
Replace prose arrows (->/<-/<->/=>) with Unicode equivalents before pandoc while preserving arrows in fenced code and inline-code spans.
Achieve corpus enrichment of at least 0.68 body ratio and 0.78 character ratio while preserving all 179 arrow fixtures and all 70 table-erosion fixtures across five render passes.
